{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check if the missing values in flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g are in the same rows
missing_flipper_idx = df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()
missing_mass_idx = df['body_mass_g'].isnull()

# Check overlap
overlap = (missing_flipper_idx & missing_mass_idx).sum()

print(f"Number of rows with missing flipper_length_mm: {missing_flipper_idx.sum()}")
print(f"Number of rows with missing body_mass_g: {missing_mass_idx.sum()}")
print(f"Number of rows with missing both: {overlap}")

# Check which rows have missing values
missing_rows = df[missing_flipper_idx | missing_mass_idx]
missing_rows[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g', 'species', 'island', 'sex']]"}
